# Create your own weekly workout plan in 10 minutes with Le Chat


You’ll finish this guide with a ready-to-use weekly workout plan that fits your goals, schedule, and fitness level — all created in under 10 minutes using Le Chat. No gym membership or fitness knowledge needed.

## Before you start
- A free [Le Chat](https://lechat.mistral.ai) account (sign up with email or Google).
- A device with internet (phone, tablet, or computer).
- About 10 minutes of your time.
- A pen and paper or a notes app to save your plan.

---

## Step 1 — Open Le Chat and start a new chat
Open your web browser or the Le Chat app on your phone. Look for a button like **“New Chat”** or a plus icon (+) in the bottom-right corner. Tap it to begin a fresh conversation. You’ll see a blank chat window with a blinking cursor and a prompt that says **“Ask anything…”** at the bottom.
You’ll know it worked when you see the empty chat ready for your first message.

💬 Example:
*Just open the app and tap “New Chat”.*

---

## Step 2 — Tell Le Chat your fitness goals and limits
In the chat box, type a clear message that includes:
- Your main goal (e.g., “get stronger,” “lose weight,” or “feel more energetic”)
- Any physical limits (e.g., “bad knees,” “no dumbbells,” or “only 20 minutes per session”)
- Days and times you can exercise (e.g., “Monday, Wednesday, Friday at 7am”)

You’ll see Le Chat start typing a response right away. It will usually ask a follow-up question to clarify your preferences.
You’ll know it worked when Le Chat replies with a summary like, “Got it! You want a strength-focused plan, 3 days a week, 20 minutes per session, no equipment.”

💬 Example:
> I want to get stronger and feel more energetic. I can only exercise 20 minutes per session, 3 days a week (Mon, Wed, Fri at 7am). I have no equipment and a minor knee issue — nothing painful, just avoid deep squats.

---

## Step 3 — Ask Le Chat to generate your weekly plan
After Le Chat confirms your details, type:
> Create a simple weekly workout plan based on what I told you. Include warm-ups, main exercises, and cool-downs. Keep each session under 20 minutes.

You’ll see Le Chat typing a response. It will usually list a 7-day plan with short exercise names and brief instructions.
You’ll know it worked when you see a clear weekly schedule with exercises like “Bodyweight Squats x3” and “Plank Hold x30 seconds.”

💬 Example:
> Create a simple weekly workout plan based on what I told you. Include warm-ups, main exercises, and cool-downs. Keep each session under 20 minutes.

---

## Step 4 — Ask for simpler instructions if needed
If the plan uses words you don’t understand, reply:
> Can you explain each exercise in simpler words? Include how to do it safely with my knee.

You’ll see Le Chat rewrite the plan with plain-language instructions and knee-friendly alternatives.
You’ll know it worked when the instructions use phrases like “stand tall and lower slowly” instead of “perform eccentric contractions.”

💬 Example:
> Can you explain each exercise in simpler words? Include how to do it safely with my knee.

---

## Step 5 — Save your plan to your phone or computer
Highlight the entire plan in the chat and copy it. Open your notes app or a blank document and paste it there. Add today’s date at the top so you can track progress.
You’ll know it worked when you have a saved note titled “My Weekly Workout Plan” with all the exercises listed.

💬 Example:
*Copy the plan, paste it into Notes or Google Docs, and add the date.*

---

## Step 6 — Set a reminder for your first session
Open your phone’s calendar or reminder app. Create a new event titled “Workout: [your goal]” for your first scheduled day and time. Set a 10-minute alert before the session starts.
You’ll know it worked when you get a notification the day before your first workout.

💬 Example:
*Create a calendar event for Monday at 7am titled “Workout: Get Stronger” with a 10-minute alert.*

---

## Common mistakes
- **Mistake:** Typing a vague goal like “I want to be fit.”
  **Fix:** Be specific: “I want to feel stronger and have more energy.”
- **Mistake:** Skipping the warm-up or cool-down because the plan looks short.
  **Fix:** Always include the warm-up and cool-down — they protect your joints and help recovery.
- **Mistake:** Ignoring your limits and trying advanced moves.
  **Fix:** Stick to the knee-friendly alternatives Le Chat suggests — safety first.

---

## What this means for you

- **In everyday life:** You’ll have a clear, realistic plan that fits your schedule and body, so you can start today without feeling overwhelmed.
- **For your business or work:** If you sit all day, this plan helps you add short movement breaks that boost energy and focus, without needing a gym.
- **If you're just getting started:** This is the easiest first move — no apps, no subscriptions, just a simple plan you can follow anywhere.

---

## Try it now
Open Le Chat, start a new chat, and type:
> Create a simple weekly workout plan for me. I want to feel stronger and have more energy. I can exercise 20 minutes, 3 days a week (Mon, Wed, Fri at 7am). I have no equipment and a minor knee issue. Include warm-ups, main exercises, and cool-downs.
